firstPlayerRule: The player who first finishes building their Campaign Strategy deck may go first. With the preconstructed starting decks, the player closest to their 18th birthday may go first.
clarifications: Play alternates between the two players.
internalEvidence: The publisher-authored Z-Man Games English manual, preserved by Tesera, was rendered and visually checked. Printed page 5 gives a deck-building completion choice and a different choice when using preconstructed decks, then specifies alternating turns. Page 8 credits Z-Man Games and designers Christian Leonhard and Jason Matthews, matching inventory BGG 46255. SHA-256: 9f8b5ba148c16c0a9996fe08303b81403d587eb102cf224f75712ae814025895. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the rendered pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The rules say each eligible player “may” go first and do not state a further tie procedure.
